answer: Because the delta stake is held until the trellis settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the willow audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 49% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A farm running 74 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
